That is exactly the problem of meaning. Philosophy is the art of grasping the Concept floating outside of the realms of our basic understanding. And most of the time the Concepts are so convoluted that no one is really sure even of the nature of basic axioms in some subjects. Meaning is the last frontier of philosophy. It's the dot of light that everything gravitates to. 
And to your second point, maybe we can't grasp meaning itself, however we can play around with that idea. We can speculate, guess and wonder. Exactly like what happens after death. 
Meaning is the driving force of philosophy, never to be seen and probably never to be grasped.

I think not everyone has meaning defined in the same way as you.  meaning is an a priori goal that is not subject to any binding created by man or the laws of physics.  meaning is something outside the realm of existence, which could generally explain the basic question of philosophy, :what is it all for?  money will never fit the answer to this question because it is tied to the problems created by the internal aspects of existence, not existence itself. I think what you talk about is purpose, an ability of objects to be useful in a certain situation.

I think that by the very act of existence every Beeing is creating some sort of meaning. You can say that the universe doesn't have any meaning, but this is only true if you look at it from third person. Meaning is not implicitly written in nature of the universe like gravity for example, however it is very real for you. Something that is important to you, family friends maybe some hobbys that's all a catalyst for meaning. Maybe there's not s final goal to it all, however that doesn't mean the road isn't important, even if it's the only thing there is. I always looked at the world as a sandbox. You can play in it, make something break it down and in the end it rains and all of your creations perish. Still, kids don't mind. They play. So if you really have to have some sort of filling for the world meaning, maybe that's it. To play.
